title: Check-in sheet
goal: Turn the page into a check-in sheet. The server holds three people as `Person` nodes connected to root, with fields `name: str` and `present: bool`: Ada, Ben and Cy, all absent at first. They are created the first time the list is requested and never duplicated. The page shows a table with one row per person: the name, the status as "NAME: absent" or "NAME: present", and a button labelled "Check in NAME". Clicking the button marks that person present on the server and the row shows "NAME: present". The stored status is shown when the page loads. You may remove the Ping button.
